archetypes.name: baseline-contract
archetypes.rationale: The plan introduces a new drift-baseline wire contract spanning several scripts and recovery paths where key or precedence drift would silently disable the guard.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect whether the proposed drift baseline is anchored at the intended moment and preserved write-once across snapshot, validator override, standalone Step 2b.5, and merged post-plan paths. Compare the planned BASELINE_* and DRIFT_* keys, zero-baseline behavior, precedence ordering, and exit-code propagation against the existing script contracts and docs. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: handoff-schema
archetypes.rationale: Removing manual_gate_b and Step 3 loop statuses touches persisted run params, resume env, parser KVs, and orchestration regexes that can easily drift apart.
archetypes.prompt_body: Check every proposed deletion of --manual, MANUAL_REQUESTED, manual_gate_b, and legacy LOOP_STATUS values against the actual producer-consumer chain. Look for stale schema fields, resume-time compatibility gaps, mismatched KV counts, enum regex drift, or tests/docs that would still depend on removed handoff states. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: operator-fence
archetypes.rationale: The plan changes when humans are asked to continue, cancel, or apply findings, so operator-facing fence consistency is a distinct plan-risk area.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review whether the Continue/Cancel and Gate B changes are consistently placed across Step 2b thin fences, standalone Step 2b.5, merged Gate B fences, discussion fences, and Step 3.5. Focus on missing non-fallthrough rc 14 arms, inconsistent completion-marker touches, blind prompts without drift context, or docs that still imply silent auto-apply. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
